MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the volume
   D. The speed of the music

2. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Singing games.
   B. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.

3. Best practice when working on Songs PERFORMING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs PERFORMING.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs PERFORMING.
   C. Practise Songs PERFORMING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs PERFORMING.

4. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   B. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   D. Damage equipment used for Dance.

5. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

6. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

7. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

8. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   B. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.

9. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   D. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

12. In three clear sentences, explain Singing games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
